notes_review: Sound: §7 explanations are placed at first technical uses, kept out of Say's own parenthesis in n. 3, and correctly withheld where Marx defines constant/variable capital, living labor and socially necessary labor-time himself; 'wages' in n. 5 is indeed an everyday use. Plain renderings of 'apologetic', 'impersonation' and 'pharisaical' avoid modern misreadings without softening the sneer.
summary: No meaning changes found: the two-fold character of labor argument, every figure, the Roscher and Wayland mockery and all quotations are intact. The text reads clearly at the target level.
